notes:
• Solo wins over Mute: a track that is both soloed and muted now plays.
• The pan knob is a balance control: turning it fades the other side down instead of moving the sound across.
• Storage looks after itself: playback files for songs not opened in 30 days are cleared, and more goes when the device runs low on space. Open songs are never touched. A song that won't fit says so plainly before it opens.
• Hosts can add MIDI parts with Add stems, and line one up with the audio by dragging it sideways on Sections & tempo.
• The Align window: a tempo can be reset, Detect ignores click wobbles, and each part says what it found in a sentence.
• Error messages say what happened in plain words, with the original under Details.
• Closing a tab, loading a set list, or leaving the mashup editor asks about unsaved changes. The SET LIST menu has Save and Save As….
• The song editor has no Save button: key, tempo and time signature save as you leave the box.
• User Guide: a new How do I… guide with every task on Mac, Windows and touch, plus search, and new Updates and Activity chapters.
• Mac and Windows: the window can't be made smaller than 800 × 600. Phones: the player and Sections & tempo fit a small screen, and Android's back gesture goes back a screen in Charts.
